scope: Transfer preparation/cancellation barrier, durable owner sealing and stale-writer exclusion
changes: Worker quiesce freezes the exact state and removes scheduled wakes without pausing other rooms.
Session refuses new input/publication, drains accepted work, commits a checkpoint and seals its durable owner/cursor.
Sealed owners cannot checkpoint, renew, release or write resident assets through ordinary domain authority.
Abort validates durable owner/epoch/cursor before resuming; lost acknowledgements and decision timeout fence local execution.
Queue saturation refuses preparation without wedging the session; shutdown does not release uncertain transfer authority.

assertions: sealed owner rejects checkpoint from another connection
sealed owner rejects direct participant wallet write
stale abort cannot resume after takeover
in-flight pre-seal writer rolls back and re-reads the seal on serializable retry
limitations: local isolated schema, retained for inspection
no production join/leave UI path exercised
Preparation/cancellation only. Production join/leave, atomic claim reassignment and source owner retirement are not implemented by this change.
Room composition still needs event/time rebasing and cross-room input idempotence.
No browser playtest or capacity measurement in this turn; earlier browser evidence retains its own version.
The PostgreSQL check only created and modified its own isolated schema; it is retained for inspection.
